nodes.title: The Peace Envoy
nodes.historical_context: Krishna arrives at the Kuru court with a final offer of peace: just five villages for the Pandavas.

nodes.title: Vishvarupa Darshana
nodes.historical_context: Duryodhana attempts to arrest Krishna, prompting him to reveal his cosmic form.

nodes.title: Karna's Origins
nodes.historical_context: Kunti meets Karna secretly by the river to reveal that he is her foremost son.
